build_github_chat_config: build a GithubChatConfig instance to translate OpenAI /v1/chat/completions to GitHub /v1/chat/completions
transform_response_github_chat: transform an httpx.Response into a ModelResponse for GitHub chat completions with usage sanitization
sanitize_usage_obj_github: sanitize a response JSON dict by replacing None token values with 0 in the usage object
convert_tool_response_json_mode: convert assistant tool call responses to JSON content strings when json_mode is enabled
map_openai_params_github: map OpenAI parameters to GitHub-compatible params replacing max_completion_tokens with max_tokens
